reason: Adds a collapsible conversation outline rail with keyword search and click-to-scroll navigation for the currently loaded web chat transcript; the README states it does not send model or provider requests.

summaries.zh: 为网页聊天记录添加可折叠的对话目录侧栏，支持按消息文本搜索并跳转到当前已加载的消息。
summaries.en: Adds a collapsible outline sidebar for web chat transcripts with keyword search and navigation to messages in the currently loaded session.

capabilities: Reads the current browser conversation session
Indexes visible user questions and assistant answers
Provides keyword filtering over indexed message text
Navigates to matching messages within the loaded transcript
